condition_other: vascular dementia (chronic cerebral hypoperfusion induced by bilateral common carotid artery stenosis, BCAS)
readout_other: Western blot; ELISA; qPCR; hippocampal field EPSP (LTP, patch clamp); novel object recognition; contextual fear conditioning; radial arm water maze; dendritic spine density (immunohistochemistry); cell viability (CCK-8)
direction_notes: LIPUS increased hippocampal Fndc5/irisin expression, enhanced hippocampal fEPSP/synaptic plasticity, increased anti-inflammatory cytokines (TGF-β, IL-10), increased dendritic spine density in OGD-injured neurons, and improved cognitive performance (novel object recognition, radial arm water maze, contextual fear) in BCAS mice; effects were reversed by Fndc5 knockdown/knockout.
safety_notes: LIPUS at the doses used did not reduce cell viability of hippocampal neuron or astrocyte cultures (CCK-8 assay); mice showing signs of hemorrhage or new-onset neurological symptoms after LIPUS were to be excluded from analysis (none reported).

exposures.label: Transcranial LIPUS to bilateral hippocampus (in vivo, BCAS mice)

target.label: bilateral hippocampus (irradiation range also covered part of forebrain)

timing.protocol_description: LIPUS used in in vivo experiments was generated by a 1-MHz single-element focused transducer (A392S; Panametrics, Waltham, MA, USA) with 50 ms burst lengths at a 5% duty cycle and a repetition frequency of 1 Hz. a 3D-print coupling cone was used to connect the mouse skull and the transducer. LIPUS was applied 24 h after BCAS and subsequently daily with a stimulation time of 5 min for a period of 28 days.

exposures.label: LIPUS applied to cultured hippocampal neurons and astrocytes (in vitro)

target.label: primary hippocampal neuron and astrocyte cultures

timing.protocol_description: A 1-MHz plane piezoelectric transducer (A394S-SU, Panametrics, Waltham, MA, USA) was used to generate LIPUS with 50 ms burst lengths at a 50% duty cycle and a repetition frequency of 10 Hz. The acoustic wave was transmitted from the plane transducer to the bottom of the cell culture plate and daily applied for a stimulation time of 5 min at a period of 2 days.

source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Transcranial LIPUS was applied 24 h after BCAS and subsequently daily with a stimulation time of 5 min at an ultrasound pressure of 0.51 MPa for a period of 28 days.
source_quotes.randomised: Finally, 242 mice were used for data analysis and randomly assigned to diferent experimental groups: Sham BCAS group (aging, n   16; adult, n   16), Sham BCAS AdFndc5 group (adult, n 24), Sham BCAS Irisin group (adult, n    24), Sham BCAS LIPUS group (aging, n   24; adult, n   24; F5KO, n   24), Sham BCAS LIPUS shLuc shFndc5 (adult, n   90).
source_quotes.blinding: All outcome analysis were carried out by independent researchers blinded to the information of experimental groups.

flags.reason: Paper gives only per-group sizes for animals receiving LIPUS across sub-studies (aging BCAS+LIPUS n=24, adult BCAS+LIPUS n=24, F5KO BCAS+LIPUS n=24, BCAS+LIPUS+shLuc/shFndc5 n=90); no single total for all LIPUS-exposed animals is stated, so group sizes are listed rather than summed.

Study combines in vivo mouse (animal) and in vitro primary hippocampal neuron/astrocyte culture (culture) work; subject_unit and n_subjects/n_sessions_per_subject given here reflect only the in vivo animal arm.

Abstract states 'ultrasound pressure of 0.51 MPa' while the Methods state 'acoustic power of 0.51 W (corresponding to ISPTA of 528 mW/cm2)' for the same in vivo LIPUS exposure – possible unit/terminology confusion (pressure vs. power) sharing the same numeral 0.51; domain (free-field vs in situ) is not specified for either quantity.
Domain (free-field vs in situ) not specified for the stated ISPTA of 528 mW/cm2.

Domain not specified for the stated in vitro ISPTA of 110 mW/cm2; a separate, seemingly unrelated value (30 mW/cm2, 'our previous study') is mentioned only as background safety context and was not used.
